title: MINOR: Make share group state partition metadata unmodifiable
body:
Wrap InitMapValue's partitions and
ShareGroupStatePartitionMetadataInfo's collections in unmodifiable
views, so that the share group state partition metadata cannot be
modified through them. Add withAddedPartitions and withRemovedPartitions
to InitMapValue to derive new values.

Use them in GroupMetadataManager and remove the copies that are no
longer needed. combineInitMaps reuses a value when only one of the maps
has the topic, and initializeShareGroupState no longer deep copies the
initializing topics to remove partitions in place.
initializedShareGroupPartitions and
sharePartitionsEligibleForOffsetDeletion no longer copy the partitions.
